title: Fourier coefficient of the balanced lift
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Form the balanced lift of $f$ to $n+1$ coordinates and then swap its input coordinates $0$ and $i+1$. The Fourier coefficient of this function at the singleton frequency $\{0\}$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
$i$ is an index among the $n$ input coordinates
